items.q: How do you keep client financial data secure?
items.a: Staff work on managed laptops inside our Da Nang office, with no local storage and access only to the systems a client approves. We are ISO 27001 certified and sign your data processing terms before any access is granted. Access is removed on the day a team member leaves the account.

items.q: Which accounting systems do your teams work in?
items.a: Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks Online and NetSuite. Other systems are possible after a short training period agreed in the statement of work.

items.q: Who reviews the work before it reaches us?
items.a: Every close pack and pay run is prepared by one accountant and checked by a senior reviewer before it is sent. Review notes stay in the working papers so your team can see what changed.

items.q: How long does it take to start?
items.a: A team of three usually starts within four weeks: one week to agree scope and access, then two to three weeks of training on your files and checklists.

items.q: Can we start with one service and add more later?
items.a: Yes. Most clients start with bookkeeping or QA and add payroll, data operations or a support desk once the first team is running.

aside.title: Have a question that is not listed?
aside.text: Send it to the team lead and get an answer within one business day.

data.title: Send us the work you want to *hand off*
data.text: Tell us the service, your systems and the monthly volume. A team lead replies with a team plan and a price range within two business days.
